mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact Bellman value equals reservation-index policy; all nonpositive one-step gain implies optimal STOP, on 6075 ordered two-box and 3420 three-box-up-to-relabeling rational instances. An exact correlated counterexample and numerical Gibbs expectations are separately checked.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q via Python Fraction; Decimal at 60 and 90 digits for Gibbs only
mathematics.conventions: Payoff is final maximum observed utility minus priced query costs; sunk initial incumbent cost excluded equally; values 0,1/2,1; STOP wins economic ties
inputs: Two-box probabilities: all 15 simplex triples of denominator 4; three-box probabilities: all 6 simplex triples of denominator 2; costs 1/20,1/10,1/5; incumbents 0,1/2,1
non_claims: Finite enumeration does not replace the analytic proof
